name: Sea Spray Resort & Marina
brand_truth: An Albury boat-building name, rebuilt after Dorian by four friends who boat, in the sheltered White Sound of Elbow Cay.
buyer: US East Coast boat owners and captains crossing to the Abacos; villa guests; second-home buyers in the $3-6M bracket.

design.signature: Slip-fit checker: LOA and draft sliders against the sourced 130 ft / 7 ft limits, boat silhouette on a dock scale and a depth gauge

current_site_findings: 'Book a Slip' redirects to a 404 page
Stay and Contact pages carry the template title and share image ('Ocealis - Webflow Ecommerce website template')
No slip count, LOA, draft or VHF on the homepage
Event buttons read 'Button Button'; events repeat three times
Contact page has no phone, VHF or address
Homepage sells homes before telling boaters where the marina is
pitch_line: Your 'Book a Slip' button goes to a 404 and your pages still carry the template's name; this concept puts 68 slips, 130 ft and 7 ft at low tide in the first screen and lets a captain check his boat before he calls.
assumptions: Slip specs (68 slips, 20-130 ft, 7 ft at low tide) from All At Sea Dec 2023 and TripAdvisor listing text: confirm current
Gas availability from Facebook page snippet
Slip rates not published: 'Rates on request'
Event descriptions 'Bring the crew' / 'For the brave' are microcopy, not facts
notes: Record said no own site; seasprayresort.com is live (Webflow template, 2026) so this is a fix-and-sharpen pitch, not a rescue. Phone +1 242 577 4696 and VHF 16 from their footer and marinas.com; no email published, so slip request ends in a read-out summary + Call + VHF. Photos hotlinked from their Webflow CDN. interact.mjs flags the two range sliders as 'dead' because it types into inputs; they work by drag/keyboard. Home page has accordion only; slip checker, enquiry tabs and residence selector are on inner pages. Scorecard: hero 4, type 5, layout 4, context 5, motion 4, depth 4, detailing 4, mobile 4, refs 4, pride 5, consistency 4.
